en.s: The Battle of Welfesholz was fought on 11 February 1115 between the Imperial army of the Emperor Henry V and a rebellious Saxon force.

zh.s: 1115年2月11日，皇帝亨利五世的帝国军队与萨克森叛军在韦尔费斯霍尔茨交战。

en.s: The Battle of Mansurah was fought from 8 to 11 February 1250, between Crusaders led by Louis IX, King of France, and Ayyubid forces led by Egypt's Sultana Shajar al-Durr, vizier Fakhr al-Din ibn al-Shaykh, Faris ad-Din Aktai, Baybars and Qutuz. It was fought in present-day Mansoura, Egypt. The Crusader force was enticed into entering the town where it was set upon by the Muslim force.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 曼苏拉战役于1250年2月8日至11日爆发，交战双方分别是法国国王路易九世率领的十字军，以及由埃及苏丹沙贾尔·杜尔、维齐尔法赫尔丁·伊本·谢赫、法里斯丁·阿克泰、拜巴尔和忽秃思率领的阿尤布军队。战役发生在今埃及曼苏拉。十字军被诱入城镇后遭穆斯林军队袭击。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Canterbury clergy conditionally recognize Henry VIII as supreme head
en.s: On 11 February 1531, the Convocation of Canterbury accepted Henry VIII’s claim to be supreme head of the English church and clergy, with the qualification “as far as the law of Christ allows.” This preceded the parliamentary Act of Supremacy of 1534.
en.n: The source calendar’s year 1534 conflated this qualified clerical recognition in 1531 with the later Act of Supremacy. February 11 follows the contemporary Old Style day with a January-start year.

zh.t: 坎特伯雷教士有条件承认亨利八世的教会首脑地位
zh.s: 1531年2月11日，坎特伯雷教士会议接受亨利八世作为英格兰教会及教士最高首脑的地位，但加上了“以基督之法允许的范围为限”的条件。议会在1534年通过《至尊法案》，是后来的另一件事。
zh.n: 原日期将1531年教士的有条件承认与1534年的《至尊法案》混淆，现已更正年份。2月11日沿用当时的旧历日期，年份按1月起年记载。

en.s: Battle of Quilacura took place during the Arauco War, fought at night, four leagues from the Bio-Bio River, between the Spanish expedition of Pedro de Valdivia and a force of Mapuche warriors led by Malloquete on February 11, 1546.

zh.s: 1546年2月11日，佩德罗·德·巴尔迪维亚率领的西班牙远征军与马普切战士在比奥比奥河以北约四西班牙里格的地方交战。马普切军由马略克特率领，战斗发生在阿劳卡战争期间，且于夜间进行。

en.t: Sarmiento de Gamboa founds Nombre de Jesús
en.s: On 11 February 1584, Pedro Sarmiento de Gamboa founded the Spanish settlement Nombre de Jesús on the Strait of Magellan, in present-day Argentina. A second settlement near modern Punta Arenas was established separately.

zh.t: 萨米恩托建立Nombre de Jesús定居点
zh.s: 1584年2月11日，佩德罗·萨米恩托·德·甘博阿在麦哲伦海峡建立西班牙定居点Nombre de Jesús，地点位于今阿根廷。另一处靠近今蓬塔阿雷纳斯的定居点则另行建立。

en.s: The Battle of Cartagena de Indias (1586) or the Capture of Cartagena de Indias was a military and naval action fought on 9–11 February 1586, of the recently declared Anglo-Spanish War that resulted in the assault and capture by English soldiers and sailors of the Spanish colony city of Cartagena de Indias (now part of Colombia) governed by Pedro de Bustos on the Spanish Main.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 卡塔赫纳-德印第亚斯战役（1586年）
zh.s: 卡塔赫纳-德印第亚斯战役（1586年）又称卡塔赫纳-德印第亚斯陷落，是英西战争初期的一场海陆战役，于1586年2月9日至11日爆发。英国士兵和水手进攻并占领了西班牙殖民城市卡塔赫纳-德印第亚斯（今属哥伦比亚），当时该城由佩德罗·德·布斯托斯管理，位于西属美洲大陆沿岸。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On 11 February 1612, a Danish-Norwegian force confronted a Swedish force under Gustavus Adolphus at Vittsjö, in present-day Sweden. The Swedish force retreated during the Kalmar War.

zh.s: 1612年2月11日，丹麦—挪威军队在今瑞典维特舍与古斯塔夫·阿道夫率领的瑞典军队交战。瑞军在这场卡尔马战争中的战斗后撤退。

en.s: The Assault on Eda sconce was an incident on 11 February 1658, when a Norwegian force under Michael Opitz attacked the Swedish Sconce at Eda. The Norwegians were successful at first, but were later repelled by the Swedish artillery fire, forcing them to withdraw. The fighting lasted for 2 hours.

zh.s: 1658年2月11日，迈克尔·奥皮茨率领的挪威军队袭击瑞典在埃达修筑的堡垒。挪威军队起初占据上风，后来遭瑞典炮火击退，被迫撤退。战斗持续了两小时。

en.s: The assault on Copenhagen (Danish: stormen på København; Swedish: stormningen av Köpenhamn), also known as the battle of Copenhagen, on 11 February 1659, was a major engagement during the Second Northern War, taking place during the Swedish siege of Copenhagen. Following the arrival of Swedish forces on Zealand on 7 August 1658, they intended to attack Copenhagen, thus conquering Denmark.

zh.s: 1659年2月11日，瑞典军队在第二次北方战争期间围攻哥本哈根，并发动大规模攻城战。这场战役也称哥本哈根战役。瑞典军队于1658年8月7日抵达西兰岛后，计划攻占哥本哈根，进而征服丹麦。

en.s: The Battle of Cavan took place in Cavan, Ireland on 11 February 1690 between forces of Williamite and Jacobite troops during the Williamite War in Ireland. It ended in a victory for the Protestant Williamites who captured, sacked and burned the town of Cavan before withdrawing to their forwarding base at Belturbet and further afield Enniskillen The local Protestant commander Colonel William Wolseley had been instructed by his overall commander Marshal Schomberg to observe and harry Cavan, as Jacobites were using it as a forwarding base to launch relief raids across Ulster for Jacobite forces.

zh.s: 1690年2月11日，爱尔兰威廉派战争期间，威廉派与詹姆斯派军队在卡文交战。新教威廉派获胜，攻占、洗劫并烧毁卡文镇，随后撤回贝尔特贝特前进基地及更远的恩尼斯基林。当地新教部队指挥官威廉·沃尔斯利上校奉总司令朔姆贝格元帅之命，监视并袭扰卡文，因为詹姆斯派将这里作为前进基地，向阿尔斯特各地发动袭击，为己方解围。

en.s: The siege of Ruthven Barracks that took place over the 10 – 11 February 1746 was part of the Jacobite rising of 1745. In August 1745 the Jacobites had unsuccessfully laid siege to the barracks being repulsed by a small group of Government soldiers. However the Jacobites returned in February 1746 this time equipped with cannon, and as a result the Government garrison surrendered.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 鲁思文兵营围城战发生于1746年2月10日至11日，是1745年詹姆斯党起义的一部分。1745年8月，詹姆斯党人曾围攻兵营，但被少量政府军击退。1746年2月，他们带着大炮再次进攻，政府军守军因此投降。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On 11 February 1747, the Battle of Grand Pré in present-day Nova Scotia, Canada, reached the end of its recorded February 10–11 fighting. French colonial, Mi’kmaq and Acadian forces defeated British colonial troops during King George’s War.
en.n: February 11 is the endpoint of the source’s February 10–11 battle range.

zh.s: 1747年2月11日，今加拿大新斯科舍省格朗普雷的战斗结束。战斗持续于2月10日至11日，法国殖民地军队、米克马克人及阿卡迪亚人的部队击败英国殖民地军队，是乔治王战争的一部分。
zh.n: 2月11日为原文所列2月10日至11日战斗的结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Van Creek was a small engagement on February 11, 1779, near Elberton, Georgia, during the American Revolutionary War. About 100 Patriot militia men sought to stop a Loyalist force of about 600 men from crossing the Savannah River to rendezvous with a British force which had recently captured Augusta, Georgia. The Loyalist force was able to flank and defeat the Patriot militia and cross the river.

zh.s: 1779年2月11日，美国独立战争期间，双方在佐治亚州埃尔伯顿附近发生小规模交战。约100名爱国者民兵试图阻止约600名效忠派越过萨凡纳河，与一支刚攻占佐治亚州奥古斯塔的英军会合。效忠派从侧翼击败爱国者民兵，并成功渡河。

en.t: US Senate opens its doors for the Gallatin debate
en.s: On February 11, 1794, the United States Senate agreed to admit the public for its consideration of Albert Gallatin’s eligibility to serve. This was a specific public session; regular public legislative sessions followed later.

zh.t: 美国参议院就加勒廷资格问题向公众开放
zh.s: 1794年2月11日，美国参议院同意在审议阿尔伯特·加勒廷的参议员资格时允许公众旁听。这次开放只针对该事项，定期向公众开放立法会议是在后来。

en.t: Jesse Fell burns anthracite on an open grate as an experiment in heating homes with coal
en.s: Jesse Fell was an early political leader in Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania. He was one of the first Pennsylvanians to successfully burn anthracite on an open air grate. Anthracite differs from wood in that it needs a draft from the bottom, and Judge Fell proved with his grate design that it was a viable heating fuel.

zh.t: 杰西·费尔在开放式炉栅上燃烧无烟煤，试验用煤取暖
zh.s: 杰西·费尔是宾夕法尼亚州威尔克斯-巴里早期的政治领袖，也是最早成功在开放式炉栅上燃烧无烟煤的人之一。无烟煤与木材不同，需要从底部进风。费尔法官通过炉栅设计证明，无烟煤可以用作取暖燃料。

en.s: The Battle of Montmirail (11 February 1814) was fought between a French force led by Emperor Napoleon and two Allied corps commanded by Fabian Wilhelm von Osten-Sacken and Ludwig Yorck von Wartenburg. In hard fighting that lasted until evening, French troops including the Imperial Guard defeated Sacken's Russian soldiers and compelled them to retreat to the north. Part of Yorck's Prussian I Corps tried to intervene in the struggle but it was also driven off. The battle occurred near Montmirail, France during the Six Days Campaign of the Napoleonic Wars. Montmirail is located 51 kilometres (32 mi) east of Meaux.

zh.s: 1814年2月11日，拿破仑皇帝率法军，与法比安·威廉·冯·奥斯滕-萨肯及路德维希·约克·冯·瓦滕堡指挥的两个联军军团，在法国蒙米拉伊附近交战。这是拿破仑战争六日战役的一部分。激战持续至晚间，包括帝国近卫军在内的法军击败萨肯的俄军，迫使其向北撤退。约克所率普鲁士第一军的一部分试图支援，也被击退。蒙米拉伊位于莫城以东51公里（32英里）。

en.t: Institution now known as UCL founded as London University
en.s: On 11 February 1826, the institution now known as University College London was founded in London, United Kingdom, as London University. Teaching began in 1828.
en.n: This is UCL’s 1826 foundation, distinct from the federal University of London established in 1836.

zh.t: 伦敦大学学院的前身成立
zh.s: 1826年2月11日，今天的伦敦大学学院在英国伦敦成立，当时名为“伦敦大学”，于1828年开始教学。
zh.n: 此条为伦敦大学学院1826年的创立，区别于1836年成立的联邦伦敦大学。

en.s: The Battle of Mariel was a small-scale naval engagement fought between the First Mexican Republic and the Spanish Empire near the Cuban port town of Mariel. The battle resulted in a Spanish victory, with the Mexican navy losing the brig Guerrero.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 马里埃尔海战是墨西哥第一共和国与西班牙帝国海军在古巴港口城镇马里埃尔附近进行的一场小规模海战。西班牙获胜，墨西哥海军损失了“格雷罗”号双桅帆船。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Gaetano Donizetti's opera La fille du régiment receives its first performance in Paris, France
en.s: La fille du régiment (French pronunciation: [la fij dy ʁeʒimɑ̃], The Daughter of the Regiment) is an opéra comique in two acts by Gaetano Donizetti, set to a French libretto by Jules-Henri Vernoy de Saint-Georges and Jean-François Bayard. It was first performed on 11 February 1840 by the Paris Opéra-Comique at the Salle de la Bourse.

zh.t: 多尼采蒂歌剧《军中女郎》在法国巴黎首演
zh.s: 《军中女郎》（法语发音：[la fij dy ʁeʒimɑ̃]，意为“军团之女”）是加埃塔诺·多尼采蒂创作的两幕喜歌剧，法语剧本由朱尔-亨利·韦尔努瓦·德·圣乔治和让-弗朗索瓦·巴亚尔撰写。该剧于1840年2月11日在巴黎喜歌剧院的交易所剧院首演。

en.t: Giuseppe Verdi's opera I Lombardi alla prima crociata receives its first performance in Milan, Italy
en.s: I Lombardi alla prima crociata (The Lombards on the First Crusade) is an operatic dramma lirico in four acts by Giuseppe Verdi set to an Italian libretto by Temistocle Solera, based on an epic poem by Tommaso Grossi, which was "very much a child of its age; a grand historical novel with a patriotic slant". Its first performance was given at the Teatro alla Scala in Milan on 11 February 1843.

zh.t: 威尔第歌剧《伦巴第人第一次十字军东征》在意大利米兰首演
zh.s: 《伦巴第人第一次十字军东征》（The Lombards on the First Crusade）是朱塞佩·威尔第创作的四幕歌剧，意大利语剧本由特米斯托克莱·索莱拉撰写，改编自托马索·格罗西的史诗。该剧于1843年2月11日在米兰斯卡拉歌剧院首演。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 11 February 1854. José María San Martín ran unopposed and was elected by the legislature. He had previously served as provisional president of the country from 30 January to 1 February 1852.

zh.s: 萨尔瓦多于1854年2月11日举行总统选举。何塞·玛丽亚·圣马丁在没有对手的情况下由议会选为总统。他此前曾于1852年1月30日至2月1日担任临时总统。

en.t: Kassa Hailu crowned Emperor Tewodros II
en.s: On February 11, 1855, Kassa Hailu was crowned emperor of Ethiopia at the church of Derasge Maryam by Abuna Salama III. He took the throne name Tewodros II.

zh.t: 卡萨·海卢加冕为埃塞俄比亚皇帝特沃德罗斯二世
zh.s: 1855年2月11日，卡萨·海卢在埃塞俄比亚德拉斯格圣玛丽亚教堂，由阿布纳·萨拉马三世主持加冕为皇帝，采用帝号特沃德罗斯二世。

en.s: The Battle of Aiken (also known as the Action at Aiken) occurred on February 11, 1865 and was part of the Carolinas campaign. The principal commanders were Union Maj. Gen. Hugh Judson Kilpatrick and Confederate Maj. Gen. Joseph Wheeler. Wheeler was able to score a minor victory over Kilpatrick. Today, an annual re-enactment is held the final full weekend in February.

zh.s: 艾肯战役又称艾肯冲突，于1865年2月11日发生，是卡罗来纳战役的一部分。主要指挥官是联邦军少将休·贾德森·基尔帕特里克和邦联军少将约瑟夫·惠勒。惠勒小胜基尔帕特里克。如今，每年2月最后一个完整周末都会举行战役重演活动。

en.t: Amadeo I abdicates the Spanish throne
en.s: On 11 February 1873, Amadeo I abdicated as king of Spain. The First Spanish Republic was proclaimed after his abdication.

zh.t: 西班牙国王阿马德奥一世退位
zh.s: 1873年2月11日，西班牙国王阿马德奥一世退位，随后西班牙第一共和国宣布成立。

en.s: The Constitution of the Empire of Japan (Kyūjitai: 大日本帝國憲法; Shinjitai: 大日本帝国憲法, romanized: Dai-Nippon Teikoku Kenpō), known informally as the Meiji Constitution (明治憲法, Meiji Kenpō), was the constitution of the Empire of Japan which was proclaimed on February 11, 1889, and remained in force between November 29, 1890, until May 2, 1947.

zh.s: 《大日本帝国宪法》（旧字：大日本帝國憲法；新字：大日本帝国憲法；罗马字：Dai-Nippon Teikoku Kenpō）通常称为《明治宪法》（明治憲法；Meiji Kenpō），是日本帝国的宪法，于1889年2月11日颁布，自1890年11月29日起生效，至1947年5月2日失效。

en.s: The siege of Lapa was a military confrontation involving the Brazilian Army, the National Guard, the Military Police of Paraná state and civilian volunteers, which took place during the Federalist Revolution in early 1894. The city of Lapa became the arena of a bloody confrontation between the loyalist republican troops, commonly called pica-paus (woodpeckers) against the maragatos, federalist rebels, who opposed the presidential form of government.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1894年初，巴西联邦革命期间，巴西陆军、国民警卫队、巴拉那州军警及平民志愿者卷入拉帕围城战。拉帕城内，通常被称为“啄木鸟”的共和派政府军，与反对总统制、被称为“马拉加托”的联邦派叛军展开血战。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On February 11, 1897, the Commercial Press was founded in Shanghai, China, initially as a printing business. It later became a major publisher of educational, reference and translated works.

zh.t: 商务印书馆在上海创立
zh.s: 1897年2月11日，商务印书馆在中国上海创立，最初从事印刷业务，后来发展为出版教材、工具书及翻译著作的重要出版机构。

en.t: First three movements of Bruckner’s Ninth Symphony premiered
en.s: On 11 February 1903, the first three movements of Anton Bruckner’s Ninth Symphony were premiered at the Musikverein in Vienna, Austria, conducted by Ferdinand Löwe in his own arrangement.

zh.t: 布鲁克纳《第九交响曲》前三乐章首演
zh.s: 1903年2月11日，布鲁克纳《第九交响曲》的前三个乐章在奥地利维也纳音乐协会大厅首演，由费迪南德·勒韦指挥，采用他自己的改编版本。

en.s: On 11 February 1906, Pope Pius X issued the encyclical Vehementer Nos, condemning France’s 1905 law separating church and state. The document was dated at St. Peter’s in Rome, in present-day Vatican City.

zh.t: 庇护十世发布《Vehementer Nos》通谕
zh.s: 1906年2月11日，教皇庇护十世发布《Vehementer Nos》通谕，反对法国1905年的政教分离法。文件署明颁布地点为罗马圣彼得，即今梵蒂冈境内。

en.s: The Battle of Şarköy or Şarköy operation (Bulgarian: Битка при Шаркьой, Turkish: Şarköy Çıkarması) took place between 9 and 11 February 1913 during the First Balkan War between Bulgaria and the Ottoman Empire. The Ottomans attempted a counter-attack but were defeated by the Bulgarians at the Battles of Bulair and Şarköy.

zh.s: 沙尔柯伊战役又称沙尔柯伊行动，发生于1913年2月9日至11日，是第一次巴尔干战争期间保加利亚与奥斯曼帝国之间的一场战役。奥斯曼军队试图反攻，但在布莱尔战役和沙尔柯伊战役中被保加利亚军队击败。

en.s: The Bakar mockery (Italian Beffa di Buccari), or Bakar raid, was a raid of the Italian Navy (Regia Marina) in the last year of World War I. Whilst it had little material effect on the war at sea, it was a particularly bold venture which had a welcome effect on Italian morale, which was at a low ebb following the defeat at Caporetto a few months prior.

en.s: The Lateran Treaty was one component of the Lateran Pacts of 1929, agreements between Italy under King Victor Emmanuel III and Duce Benito Mussolini and the Holy See under Pope Pius XI to settle the long-standing Roman question. The treaty recognised Vatican City as an independent state under the sovereignty of the Holy See. Italy also agreed to give the Catholic Church financial compensation for the loss of the Papal States. In 1948, the Lateran Treaty was recognized in the Constitution of Italy as regulating the relations between the Italian Republic and the Catholic Church. While the treaty was significantly revised in 1984, ending the status of Catholicism as the sole state religion of Italy, the Vatican remains a distinct sovereign entity to the present day. The treaty and associated pacts were named after the Lateran Palace, where they were signed on 11 February 1929.

zh.s: 拉特兰条约是1929年《拉特兰协定》的组成部分之一。协定由意大利国王维克托·埃马努埃莱三世、首相贝尼托·墨索里尼与教宗庇护十一世领导的罗马教廷签署，以解决长期存在的罗马问题。条约承认梵蒂冈城国为由罗马教廷主权管辖的独立国家，意大利还同意向天主教会补偿其失去教皇国的损失。1948年，意大利宪法确认该条约规范意大利共和国与天主教会的关系。1984年，条约经大幅修订，天主教不再是意大利唯一的国教；梵蒂冈至今仍是独立主权实体。该条约及相关协定以签署地拉特兰宫命名，签署日期为1929年2月11日。

en.t: Nelson Mandela walks free after 27 years
en.s: Nelson Mandela was released from Victor Verster Prison near Paarl after more than twenty-seven years in custody. His release followed President F. W. de Klerk's announcement that the African National Congress and other banned organizations would be legalized. Crowds watched as Mandela left prison with Winnie Mandela, and he later addressed supporters in Cape Town. The event became an international symbol of the movement against apartheid, but it did not immediately end the political conflict or racial legislation. Mandela subsequently participated in difficult negotiations that helped lead to South Africa's first national election based on universal adult suffrage in 1994.

zh.t: 纳尔逊·曼德拉结束27年监禁，重获自由
zh.s: 纳尔逊·曼德拉被关押超过27年后，从帕尔附近的维克托·韦斯特监狱获释。此前，总统F.W.德克勒克宣布，将使非洲人国民大会及其他遭禁组织恢复合法地位。曼德拉与温妮·曼德拉走出监狱时，人群在旁守候；他随后在开普敦向支持者讲话。获释成为国际反种族隔离运动的象征，但并未立即结束政治冲突或种族法律。曼德拉此后参与艰难谈判，推动南非于1994年首次举行以成年公民普选权为基础的全国选举。

en.t: Establishment of Unrepresented Nations and Peoples Organization
en.s: The Unrepresented Nations and Peoples Organization (UNPO) is an international organization established to facilitate the voices of unrepresented and marginalized nations and peoples worldwide. It was formed on 11 February 1991 at the Peace Palace in The Hague, Netherlands. Its members consist of indigenous peoples, minorities, and unrecognized or occupied territories.

en.s: STS-82 was the 22nd flight of the Space Shuttle Discovery and the 82nd mission of the Space Shuttle program. It was NASA's second mission to service the Hubble Space Telescope, during which Discovery's crew repaired and upgraded the telescope's scientific instruments, increasing its research capabilities. Discovery launched from Kennedy Space Center, Florida, on February 11, 1997, returning to Earth on February 21, 1997, at Kennedy Space Center.

en.s: STS-99 was a Space Shuttle mission using Endeavour, that launched on 11 February 2000 from Kennedy Space Center, Florida. The primary objective of the mission was the Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) project. This was also the last solo flight of Endeavour; all future flights for Endeavour became devoted to the International Space Station. STS-99 was also the first Shuttle mission of the 2000s.

en.s: The Battle of the Buliok Complex took place on 11 February 2003 in an area within the provinces of Maguindanao and Cotabato in Mindanao, Philippines. The 60-hectare complex, which stretches from Pikit, Cotabato to Pagalungan, Maguindanao, was a stronghold of the Muslim separatist Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF). Accused by the Philippine government of harboring members of Pentagon, a notorious kidnap-for-ransom gang operating in Mindanao, the MILF was attacked in the Buliok complex by the Armed Forces of the Philippines under orders from then-President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo.

en.s: On 11 February 2014, an Algerian Air Force Lockheed C-130H-30 Hercules aircraft crashed into Djebel Fertas mountain near Aïn Kercha, Oum El Bouaghi Province, Algeria; with 74 passengers and 4 crew on board. Seventy-seven bodies were discovered at the site, along with one survivor. Preliminary reports suggest that bad weather conditions might have caused the crash. Eyewitness accounts describe the aircraft clipping a mountain before crashing.This was the first reported air disaster in Algeria since the 2003 crash of Air Algérie Flight 6289.
